# UNI Gate Registry (rendered)

**Source of truth:** `evidence/gates.ndjson` (append-only NDJSON, one row per gate, schema `production/schemas/gate_row.schema.json`).
**Do not edit this file by hand.** It is the rendered view of the ledger. To change a verdict, append a new row to `evidence/gates.ndjson` (never mutate an old row) and re-render with `node viewer/render_gates.cjs`.

**Verdict vocabulary (canonical, never percent-scored):** `PASS` / `PARTIAL` / `FAIL` / `WITHHELD` / `PENDING`.
**Evidence classes:** A = independently reproduced, B = observed-with-artifact, C = command-output, Sec = security-relevant-unproven, pending = not-yet-established.

---
